subject.title: fix(config): reject unsupported MCP disabled config

question: After the misleading inverse-value guidance is fixed, should MCP configurations containing the unsupported `disabled` key fail validation until the operator runs doctor repair?
rationale: The repository policy supports canonical-only runtime configuration and doctor migrations, but this still intentionally introduces a fail-closed upgrade step for existing operator files.

options.title: Accept fail-closed migration
options.body: Reject `disabled`, provide accurate value-aware guidance, and rely on `openclaw doctor --fix` as the supported upgrade path.

options.title: Preserve permissive startup
options.body: Continue accepting the unknown key and surface only a non-blocking diagnostic, avoiding startup interruption but retaining an ineffective configuration state.

recommendation.title: Accept fail-closed migration
recommendation.body: Reject `disabled`, provide accurate value-aware guidance, and rely on `openclaw doctor --fix` as the supported upgrade path.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged MCP configuration and runtime work most directly established the activation contract affected by this compatibility decision.
